meta.purpose: Working vocabulary for a composing agent. Not an irreducible set — measured, none exists.

measured.coverage_growth: ~5 composites unlocked per atom added, linear from pick 1 to pick 60
measured.finding: 61 shallow independent trees, not one deep tree

how_to_use: set_a is the atom vocabulary: 200 of 585, carrying most references, every domain root guaranteed present.
set_b is the level-2 layer: 200 composites that other entries actually reach for. This is where a composer's leverage is.
roots are the bottom node of each of the 61 trees — the atom that domain's own composites use most. Start here when entering a domain cold.
A symbol may collide across domains. Always read (domain, symbol) as the key, never symbol alone.
cautions: Recipes use '+' for seven different relations. See OPERATORS.md before reading a recipe as a procedure.
Ingredient resolution is name/symbol matching with same-domain preference. False positives exist.
'uses' counts how many other entries name this one as an ingredient. It is a popularity measure, not a distance.

set_a_atoms.definition: A structural breach or trauma that disrupts function (cut, burn, fracture).

set_a_atoms.name: Immunity
set_a_atoms.definition: The system's ability to recognize and neutralize pathogens/toxins.

set_a_atoms.name: Self-Assembly
set_a_atoms.definition: The spontaneous organization of components into a larger, functional structure without external direction.

set_a_atoms.name: Ego
set_a_atoms.definition: The sense of a separate, bounded self. The "I" that experiences and acts.

set_a_atoms.name: Mindfulness
set_a_atoms.definition: The disciplined cultivation of non-judgmental attention to the present moment.

set_a_atoms.name: Catabolism
set_a_atoms.definition: The breakdown of complex molecules to release energy (exothermic).

set_a_atoms.name: Frame
set_a_atoms.definition: The context that defines what is "inside" and "outside." The boundary of the game.

set_a_atoms.name: Reality
set_a_atoms.definition: The totality of all that exists. The sum total of what is the case.

set_a_atoms.name: Transmission
set_a_atoms.definition: Light passes through a material (transparency).

set_a_atoms.name: Grief
set_a_atoms.definition: The deep, slow, enduring response to loss. The "mourning."

set_a_atoms.name: Witness (Pathological)
set_a_atoms.definition: The one who sees and acknowledges suffering. The "holder."

set_a_atoms.name: Motivation
set_a_atoms.definition: drive to close the gap between here and the goal

set_a_atoms.name: Valence
set_a_atoms.definition: positive or negative, calm or aroused; it biases choice

set_a_atoms.name: Measurement
set_a_atoms.definition: observing forces one of them

set_a_atoms.name: Entanglement
set_a_atoms.definition: two things correlated without a visible link

set_a_atoms.name: Rhythm
set_a_atoms.definition: The pattern of events over time. Regular or irregular intervals. The pulse of the system.

set_a_atoms.name: Duration
set_a_atoms.definition: The objective length of time an event occupies (seconds, frames). Measurable, uniform.

set_a_atoms.name: Magical Link
set_a_atoms.definition: A connection between two objects that allows magic to affect one by acting on the other.

set_a_atoms.name: Fractal Dimension
set_a_atoms.definition: A dimension that is not an integer (e.g., 1.5). Self-similarity across scales.

set_a_atoms.name: Evolution
set_a_atoms.definition: Gradual change over time. The "unfolding."

set_a_atoms.name: Metamorphosis
set_a_atoms.definition: A dramatic, complete change of form. The "rebirth."

set_a_atoms.name: Sensory Modality
set_a_atoms.definition: The specific way an animal perceives the world (sight, hearing, smell, vibration, electroreception).

set_a_atoms.name: Clock (Automaton)
set_a_atoms.definition: The temporal pulse that drives transitions. The "tick."

set_a_atoms.name: Process
set_a_atoms.definition: An automated sequence of actions. The "running program."

set_a_atoms.name: Reflection
set_a_atoms.definition: The consideration of one's own learning process. The "meta."

set_a_atoms.name: Lever
set_a_atoms.definition: a rigid bar turning about a point

set_a_atoms.name: Scar
set_a_atoms.definition: The permanent mark left by a wound. The "reminder."

set_a_atoms.name: Mortality
set_a_atoms.definition: The awareness of inevitable death. The "final countdown."

set_a_atoms.name: Knot
set_a_atoms.definition: An embedding of a circle into 3D space that is not unknotted. A tangled loop.

set_a_atoms.name: Becoming
set_a_atoms.definition: The process of moving from one form to another. The "what it is becoming."

set_a_atoms.name: Current
set_a_atoms.definition: charge flowing

set_a_atoms.name: Dissent
set_a_atoms.definition: The expression of disagreement with a prevailing view or authority.

set_a_atoms.name: Echo
set_a_atoms.definition: The reflection of a sound wave off a surface. Delay indicates distance.

set_a_atoms.name: Misrepresentation
set_a_atoms.definition: act to make another's model wrong

set_a_atoms.name: Cell value
set_a_atoms.definition: a value at a position

set_b_level2.name: Integration
set_b_level2.definition: The integration of multiple connections into a coherent whole.

set_b_level2.name: Adaptation
set_b_level2.definition: a population comes to fit its surroundings

set_b_level2.name: Practice
set_b_level2.definition: The act of applying knowledge repeatedly to develop skill. The "repetition."

set_b_level2.name: Move
set_b_level2.definition: Moving an object from A to B. Translational action.

set_b_level2.name: Grab
set_b_level2.definition: Taking hold of an object. Preparing for further action.

set_b_level2.name: Strategy
set_b_level2.definition: A complete plan of action across all possible states. A mapping from states to actions.

set_b_level2.name: Ecosystem
set_b_level2.definition: a self-sustaining community

set_b_level2.name: Break
set_b_level2.definition: The interruption of a habit by a novel stimulus or conscious intervention.

set_b_level2.name: Market
set_b_level2.definition: many buyers and sellers at agreed prices

set_b_level2.name: Observe
set_b_level2.definition: The act of attending to information. The "looking."

set_b_level2.name: Cycle
set_b_level2.definition: The complete, recurring sequence of sleep stages across a night.

set_b_level2.name: Sleep
set_b_level2.definition: A period of zero activity that resets the system. Full recharge.

set_b_level2.name: Lens
set_b_level2.definition: A curved transparent medium. Converging (convex) focuses light; diverging (concave) spreads it.

set_b_level2.name: Sacrifice
set_b_level2.definition: give something up to see the structure

set_b_level2.name: Shift
set_b_level2.definition: The fundamental act of transformation: moving from one form to another.

set_b_level2.name: Focus
set_b_level2.definition: one element made distinct enough to draw attention

set_b_level2.name: Run
set_b_level2.definition: an airborne phase; faster, costlier, ballistic

set_b_level2.name: Gift
set_b_level2.definition: Giving without expectation of immediate return. The "present."

set_b_level2.name: Release
set_b_level2.definition: Letting go of an object. Dropping, throwing.

set_b_level2.name: Press
set_b_level2.definition: A simple, discrete input. A button press, a click. The atomic action.

set_b_level2.name: Communication
set_b_level2.definition: The transmission of information between agents. Language, gesture, symbol.

set_b_level2.name: Continuation
set_b_level2.definition: things along a line read as one path

set_b_level2.name: Empathy
set_b_level2.definition: simulate what another is experiencing

set_b_level2.name: Chaos
set_b_level2.recipe: Sens high + Coup high + Var extreme
set_b_level2.definition: deterministic and unpredictable; small differences explode; bounded, never repeats

set_b_level2.name: Walk
set_b_level2.definition: alternating contact; something always touching

set_b_level2.name: Differentiation
set_b_level2.definition: a general cell becomes a specific one

set_b_level2.name: Contain
set_b_level2.definition: a thing is held inside a boundary

set_b_level2.name: Rotate
set_b_level2.definition: an object turns about a centre

set_b_level2.name: Evolve
set_b_level2.definition: Gradual change over time.

set_b_level2.name: Microbiome
set_b_level2.definition: The community of microorganisms living in/on a host organism.

set_b_level2.name: Counter
set_b_level2.definition: Responding to an opponent's action with a specifically timed counter-move.

set_b_level2.name: Replay
set_b_level2.definition: Re-execute a previous action sequence exactly as it was performed.

set_b_level2.name: Delay
set_b_level2.definition: A predetermined lag between trigger and response. A delayed trap.

set_b_level2.name: Mirror
set_b_level2.definition: A perfectly smooth surface. It redirects a light ray at an equal but opposite angle. The angle is reversible.

set_b_level2.name: Reset
set_b_level2.definition: return to a known state deliberately, rather than being returned to one

set_b_level2.name: Burst
set_b_level2.definition: a spike of activity, then quiet

set_b_level2.name: Criticality
set_b_level2.definition: poised between order and disorder; maximal information processing

set_b_level2.name: Saturation
set_b_level2.definition: output at a ceiling; more input changes nothing

set_b_level2.name: Hop
set_b_level2.definition: one ballistic leap on elastic recoil

set_b_level2.name: Collapsed mass
set_b_level2.definition: so dense nothing escapes

set_b_level2.name: Predator
set_b_level2.definition: consumes other organisms

set_b_level2.name: Switch
set_b_level2.definition: a controllable gap

set_b_level2.name: Decompose
set_b_level2.definition: break a goal into ordered parts

set_b_level2.name: Array
set_b_level2.definition: contiguous, indexed

set_b_level2.name: Expand
set_b_level2.definition: heating grows volume

set_b_level2.name: Bind
set_b_level2.definition: features group into one thing

set_b_level2.name: Revolt
set_b_level2.definition: Sudden, radical change of a system.

set_b_level2.name: Convert
set_b_level2.definition: The conversion of one substance into another.

set_b_level2.name: Story
set_b_level2.definition: A structured narrative. A sequence of events connected by causality and meaning.

set_b_level2.name: Utterance
set_b_level2.definition: A sentence spoken in a specific context with a specific intention. The unit of communicative action.

set_b_level2.name: Capacity
set_b_level2.definition: The maximum flow that an edge can carry. Exceed it; congestion occurs.

set_b_level2.name: Route
set_b_level2.definition: Find a path from source to destination. Connectivity is the first requirement.

set_b_level2.name: Consolidation
set_b_level2.definition: The process by which a fragile trace becomes stable and long-lasting (e.g., overnight).

set_b_level2.name: Accelerate
set_b_level2.definition: Speed up the flow of time for a specific object or region.

set_b_level2.name: Fluency
set_b_level2.definition: how easily a thing is processed; high fluency reads as good

set_b_level2.name: Closure
set_b_level2.definition: the mind completes a broken pattern

set_b_level2.name: Regulation
set_b_level2.definition: deliberately modulate a response; reappraise what a thing means

set_b_level2.name: Momentum
set_b_level2.definition: accumulated tendency to continue; distinct from inertia, which is resistance to starting

set_b_level2.name: Glide
set_b_level2.definition: descend shallowly; trade height for distance

set_b_level2.name: Fly
set_b_level2.definition: sustained, and it costs continuously

set_b_level2.name: Roll
set_b_level2.definition: the whole body turns about an axis

set_b_level2.name: Kinematic chain
set_b_level2.definition: connected rigid segments

set_b_level2.name: Equilibrate
set_b_level2.definition: find the force that reaches balance

set_b_level2.name: Graph
set_b_level2.definition: nodes and edges

set_b_level2.name: Markov chain
set_b_level2.definition: what follows what, with probability

set_b_level2.name: Recombination
set_b_level2.definition: one becomes two different

set_b_level2.name: Division
set_b_level2.definition: one becomes two identical

set_b_level2.name: Capacitor
set_b_level2.definition: stores charge

set_b_level2.name: Conductor
set_b_level2.definition: lets charge pass

set_b_level2.name: Contract
set_b_level2.definition: cooling shrinks it

set_b_level2.name: Freeze
set_b_level2.definition: liquid becomes solid

set_b_level2.name: Texture
set_b_level2.definition: local structure

set_b_level2.name: Pretext
set_b_level2.definition: act inefficiently to hide the efficient path

set_b_level2.name: Mislead
set_b_level2.definition: supply a false premise

set_b_level2.name: Trajectory
set_b_level2.definition: track the paths of a few moving things

set_b_level2.name: Cycle
set_b_level2.definition: A cyclical transformation. The "wheel of becoming."

set_b_level2.name: Emerge
set_b_level2.definition: The arising of new properties from change.

set_b_level2.name: Performance
set_b_level2.definition: The execution of skill in a performance context.

set_b_level2.name: Mastery
set_b_level2.definition: Deep, integrated, intuitive mastery of a domain.

set_b_level2.name: Refine
set_b_level2.definition: The improvement of a skill through feedback.

set_b_level2.name: Detect
set_b_level2.definition: The automaton detects a specific input or state condition. The "sensing."

set_b_level2.name: Plasmid
set_b_level2.definition: A small, circular piece of DNA that can be transferred between bacteria.

set_b_level2.name: Release
set_b_level2.definition: The emotional release that brings relief.

set_b_level2.name: Counterfactual
set_b_level2.definition: Mentally simulating the outcome of the rejected alternative. "What if I had chosen differently?"

set_b_level2.name: Chain
set_b_level2.definition: A series of actions linked together. The combo.

set_b_level2.name: Atmosphere
set_b_level2.definition: The emotional coloring of the world. A room can feel "heavy," "light," or "tense."

set_b_level2.name: Respiration
set_b_level2.definition: Aerobic energy production. Glucose + O₂ → CO₂ + H₂O + ATP (high yield).

set_b_level2.name: Cyclone
set_b_level2.definition: A rotating storm system. Winds spiral inward and upward. Counterclockwise (Northern Hemisphere).

set_b_level2.name: Discourse
set_b_level2.definition: A connected series of utterances. A conversation, a speech, a text.

set_b_level2.name: Alliance
set_b_level2.definition: A formal or informal agreement to act cooperatively. A pact.

set_b_level2.name: Cooperation
set_b_level2.definition: Two or more agents work together toward a common outcome. Mutual benefit.

set_b_level2.name: Decelerate
set_b_level2.definition: Slow down the flow of time for a specific object or region.

set_b_level2.name: Composite
set_b_level2.definition: Combine two materials (e.g., fiberglass, reinforced concrete). The composite has the hardness of one and the toughness of the other. Resists cracks.

set_b_level2.name: Competition
set_b_level2.definition: pressure toward lower price or higher quality

set_b_level2.name: Production
set_b_level2.definition: transform into something worth more

set_b_level2.name: Oscillating reaction
set_b_level2.definition: cycles between states on a chemical clock

set_b_level2.name: Isomerisation
set_b_level2.definition: same parts, different arrangement

set_b_level2.name: Dehydration
set_b_level2.definition: water is driven out

set_b_level2.name: Synthesis
set_b_level2.definition: two become one more complex

set_b_level2.name: Deep rest
set_b_level2.definition: complete shutdown; unresponsive by design

set_b_level2.name: Adaptive homeostasis
set_b_level2.definition: the baseline shifts to stay stable under changing load

set_b_level2.name: Hysteresis
set_b_level2.definition: the state depends on the path taken; the way up differs from the way down

set_b_level2.name: Runaway
set_b_level2.definition: growth with nothing to stop it

set_b_level2.name: Metastability
set_b_level2.definition: near a stable point, easily kicked out of it

set_b_level2.name: Dash
set_b_level2.definition: brief extreme acceleration; crosses a gap at once

set_b_level2.name: Tumble
set_b_level2.definition: rotational momentum recovering balance

set_b_level2.name: Swim
set_b_level2.definition: gravity offset by buoyancy

set_b_level2.name: Crawl
set_b_level2.definition: many low contact points; slow, stable, low

set_b_level2.name: Not
set_b_level2.definition: input on, output off

set_b_level2.name: Torque
set_b_level2.definition: turning force is force times distance

set_b_level2.name: Cascade
set_b_level2.definition: trigger a chain of a few linked events

set_b_level2.name: Sequence of operations
set_b_level2.definition: several in a row

set_b_level2.name: Tree
set_b_level2.definition: parent and child

set_b_level2.name: Decomposer
set_b_level2.definition: breaks down what is left

set_b_level2.name: Diode
set_b_level2.definition: one-way

set_b_level2.name: Lower vigilance
set_b_level2.definition: act against your own path to be discounted

set_b_level2.name: Mimic
set_b_level2.definition: copy another's attention pattern

set_b_level2.name: Anchor
set_b_level2.definition: fix a base so the centre of mass stays over it

set_b_level2.name: Ballistics
set_b_level2.definition: work out an arc

set_b_level2.name: Camouflage
set_b_level2.definition: match what is around you

set_b_level2.name: Wayfind
set_b_level2.definition: integrate motion, reset at landmarks

set_b_level2.name: Optimise
set_b_level2.definition: balance known reward against unknown

set_b_level2.name: Schematise
set_b_level2.definition: treat a cluster as one thing

set_b_level2.name: Filter
set_b_level2.definition: a boundary some things cross

set_b_level2.name: Expansion
set_b_level2.definition: the extent itself grows

set_b_level2.name: Orbit
set_b_level2.definition: falling forever without landing

set_b_level2.name: Attraction
set_b_level2.definition: massive things pull

set_b_level2.name: Collapse
set_b_level2.definition: observing forces one

set_b_level2.name: Electromagnet
set_b_level2.definition: current makes a field

set_b_level2.name: Resistor
set_b_level2.definition: a controlled obstruction

set_b_level2.name: Convection
set_b_level2.definition: hot rises, cold sinks

set_b_level2.name: Conduction
set_b_level2.definition: heat crosses to an adjacent cold thing

set_b_level2.name: Threshold map
set_b_level2.definition: where variation is high

set_b_level2.name: Stand-in
set_b_level2.definition: use a neutral object in place of the real one

set_b_level2.name: Entrain
set_b_level2.definition: synchronise with another's rhythm

set_b_level2.name: Decoy
set_b_level2.definition: attend to one thing to redirect inference about another

set_b_level2.name: Conceal
set_b_level2.definition: occupy the part another cannot see

set_b_level2.name: Measure
set_b_level2.definition: assign a magnitude to a spatial feature

set_b_level2.name: Imitate
set_b_level2.definition: predict a consequence, then perform it

set_b_level2.name: Predict
set_b_level2.definition: infer the next state from the last

set_b_level2.name: Chunk
set_b_level2.definition: a repeating sequence becomes one unit

set_b_level2.name: Pass through
set_b_level2.definition: a thing crosses an opening

set_b_level2.name: Collide
set_b_level2.definition: a struck thing moves; an unstruck one does not

set_b_level2.name: Recolour
set_b_level2.definition: appearance changes, identity does not

set_b_level2.name: Spark
set_b_level2.definition: The precipitation of change.

set_b_level2.name: Alter
set_b_level2.definition: A change in fundamental nature.

set_b_level2.name: Collaborative
set_b_level2.definition: Learning through interaction with others. The "community."

set_b_level2.name: Generalize
set_b_level2.definition: The application of knowledge from one domain to another. The "application."

set_b_level2.name: Recall
set_b_level2.definition: The act of retrieving stored knowledge. The "remembering."

set_b_level2.name: Memorize
set_b_level2.definition: The act of committing information to memory. The "retention."

set_b_level2.name: Traverse
set_b_level2.definition: Moving through a network. The "pathfinding."

set_b_level2.name: Connect
set_b_level2.definition: The fundamental act of network construction. Creating a link.

set_b_level2.name: Iterate
set_b_level2.definition: The repeated application of transitions over time. The "automaton running."

set_b_level2.name: Adhere
set_b_level2.definition: A bacterium attaches to a surface and begins to form a biofilm.

set_b_level2.name: Divide
set_b_level2.definition: The fundamental act of cellular reproduction. Mitosis, binary fission.

set_b_level2.name: Ascend
set_b_level2.definition: The act of waking up. The return to the conscious world.

set_b_level2.name: Sell
set_b_level2.definition: Giving a resource in exchange for currency. The "sale."

set_b_level2.name: Buy
set_b_level2.definition: Acquiring a resource by giving currency. The "purchase."

set_b_level2.name: Longing
set_b_level2.definition: A desire for something that is absent or distant. The ache of separation.

set_b_level2.name: Passion
set_b_level2.definition: An intense, sustained desire that becomes part of one's identity.

set_b_level2.name: Replace
set_b_level2.definition: Substituting a new behavior for an old one in response to the same cue.

set_b_level2.name: Reframe
set_b_level2.definition: Change the conceptual lens through which a situation is viewed.

set_b_level2.name: Counterargue
set_b_level2.definition: Generate an argument against a proposition. The "devil's advocate."

set_b_level2.name: Connect
set_b_level2.definition: Link two objects or systems.

set_b_level2.name: Swing
set_b_level2.definition: Move an object or self in an arc.

set_b_level2.name: Hold
set_b_level2.definition: Maintaining a grip or position over time. The "sustained action."

set_b_level2.name: Pain
set_b_level2.definition: The raw, unpleasant, bodily-embedded feeling of damage or threat.

set_b_level2.name: Uptake
set_b_level2.definition: Move the monomers from the gut into the bloodstream/interior.

set_b_level2.name: Ontological shock
set_b_level2.definition: The realization that your reality is a simulation. The "red pill" moment.

set_b_level2.name: Evapotranspiration
set_b_level2.definition: Water evaporates from the surface and transpires from plants. The source of atmospheric moisture.

set_b_level2.name: Convection
set_b_level2.definition: Warm, moist air rises. Cooler, denser air sinks. The vertical circulation of the atmosphere.

set_b_level2.name: Epidemic
set_b_level2.definition: A disease spreads rapidly through a community. Exponential growth.

set_b_level2.name: Ambiguity
set_b_level2.definition: A sentence with more than one possible meaning. "I saw the man with the telescope."

set_b_level2.name: Interpretation
set_b_level2.definition: The process of deriving meaning from a text. The reader actively constructs meaning.

set_b_level2.name: Reference
set_b_level2.definition: The relationship between a symbol and the object/event it points to. The act of naming.

set_b_level2.name: Sentence
set_b_level2.definition: A structured sequence of words that expresses a complete thought. The unit of propositional meaning.

set_b_level2.name: Gratitude
set_b_level2.definition: Positive valence toward an agent who provided a benefit. Promotes reciprocity.

set_b_level2.name: Shame
set_b_level2.definition: Negative valence directed at the self for a social failure. Promotes withdrawal.

set_b_level2.name: Pride
set_b_level2.definition: Positive valence directed at the self for an accomplishment. Promotes future effort.

set_b_level2.name: Guilt
set_b_level2.definition: Negative valence directed at the self for a perceived transgression. Promotes reparation.

set_b_level2.name: Slice
set_b_level2.definition: Cut a higher-dimensional object to see its lower-dimensional shadow. A 4D hypersphere appears as a 3D sphere that changes size.

set_b_level2.name: Wrap
set_b_level2.definition: Glue opposite edges of a rectangle. Creates a cylinder, torus, or Klein bottle. The grid wraps around.

set_b_level2.name: Recall
set_b_level2.definition: Actively reconstruct a memory from a partial cue. The act of bringing the past into the present.

set_b_level2.name: Fatalism
set_b_level2.definition: The belief that outcomes are predetermined. Action is meaningless.

set_b_level2.name: Exploit
set_b_level2.definition: A sequence of actions that leverages a rule interaction not intended by the designer. A "cheat" within the rules.

set_b_level2.name: Ruleset
set_b_level2.definition: The complete set of rules that define the game. The game's "constitution."

set_b_level2.name: Play
set_b_level2.definition: Engage in the game. Perform an action within the magic circle.

set_b_level2.name: Gossip
set_b_level2.definition: Information about an individual's reputation spreads through the network.

set_b_level2.name: Imitation
set_b_level2.definition: Copy the actions of another agent. Learning through observation.

set_b_level2.name: Nostalgia
set_b_level2.definition: A bittersweet longing for a past state. The desire to return to a previous temporal configuration.

set_b_level2.name: Project
set_b_level2.definition: Simulate the future state of the grid N frames ahead. See the consequences before they happen.

set_b_level2.name: Wait
set_b_level2.definition: Do nothing for a specified number of frames. Allows other processes to catch up.

set_b_level2.name: Soundscape
set_b_level2.definition: The entire acoustic environment as perceived by a listener. The background hum of existence.

set_b_level2.name: Coherence
set_b_level2.definition: A measure of how "together" different parts of a sound wave are. High coherence = a pure tone; low = noise.

set_b_level2.name: Echolocation
set_b_level2.definition: Emit a sound pulse; measure the time until the echo returns. Distance = (speed × time) / 2. Maps the environment in darkness.

set_b_level2.name: Periscope
set_b_level2.definition: Two parallel mirrors at 45°. Allows you to see over/around obstacles without exposing yourself.

set_b_level2.name: Filter
set_b_level2.definition: A material that absorbs some wavelengths and transmits others (e.g., a red filter only lets red through).
